title: Frontend Engineer
intro: Join the product team building our customer-facing web application. You will own UI features end to end, from design handoff to production.

requirements.text: Solid TypeScript, at least 2 years in production
Hands-on with a modern UI framework (React, Vue or Angular), 2+ years

text:
Frontend Engineer

Join the product team building our customer-facing web application. You will own UI features end to end, from design handoff to production.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional frontend development
- Solid TypeScript, at least 2 years in production
- Hands-on with a modern UI framework (React, Vue or Angular), 2+ years
- Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals
- Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs

Nice to have
- Frontend testing with Jest, Cypress or Playwright
- State management or server-side rendering (Redux, Next.js)
- Knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG)
- Comfortable with Git workflows
